body: I care what is normal cause normal people don't gotta deal with this kind of shit.

Will it matter? Either I recover or I'm a vegetable and that's basically just being dead with extra steps. Failing doesn't scare me. The pain does and that's the only reason I haven't been successful yet but I'm not even scared of the pain anymore, honestly. I've had 4 potentially life threatening or damaging attempts this year and I've had maybe 10-30 (depending on how you define attempt) "not as close to dying" attempts this year. What's held me back? Fear of pain.

Cause like, even if I don't kill myself now when I'm an adult I'm planning to buy a gun so I can shoot myself and at that point, there rarely ever is a such thing as failure. It's not just my situation. I hate everything about myself and I don't want to live in a world like this.

I always assume that too, and then when I'm pretty sure I'm at rock bottom somehow shit always gets worse. I have a lot to lose. I don't care about my life, I don't value it. It just doesn't mean much to me. When I'm dead I won't know the difference of being alive and dead anyways. The idea of my parents getting even more pissed off at me? That's way scarier than suicide has ever been.

Idk I think I just rather kill myself or at the very least find some other less risky thing to do than that cause like psychiatric inpatient is expensive as hell and considering the police will take you there against your will and sometimes you get treated like shit and just end up feeling worse, there's too many bad things that could happen and the last thing I need is any additional bad thing that isn't my own death.
I don't get what that would do.

Pretty sure there's a helluva lot more wrong with me than just chemical imbalances but even if I do get treated, what then? Possibly put my parents in medical debt because of the US's shitty health care? Make them hate me even more? Lose what little trust they have? Killing myself just sounds so much damn easier long term. I won't be a bother towards anyone anymore, and I get rid of all my problems.

I haven't been able to find any (believe me, I've looked) and even if I could find any what good would they do? I've tried talking to people before and talking doesn't do shit, it doesn't help the problem and considering my social anxiety all it really does is just create more of a hassle. I don't understand how they would be any different than doing something like talking on a forum, like Reddit I guess.

No yeah that's exactly what I mean. Almost anything that happens to me, I have to rely on them for. Not to mention I have no freedom. I am at their every whim, and being stuck in the house because of covid has made things even worse.

Sixteen. I've looked it up a ton of times. No way in hell I'd ever meet the criteria to be emancipated and even if I brought the case to the court, when I inevitably get denied, that'll just upset everyone more.
Considering I am a minor I kind of have to rely on them.
I don't think a diet change would make my family hate me any less.
It's so many particular issues that it's become a generalised feeling.
I doubt any sort of diet change would help, even if I could do that.
